label: sprint review
definition: The meeting at the end of a sprint, on Monday, where the owner inspects the increments against the sprint goal and the backlog is adjusted for what comes next. It closes the sprint's milestone.
is_not: The retrospective: the review inspects the product; the retrospective inspects how the team worked.
A code review: a code review reads one PR before it merges; the sprint review looks at what already merged.
A status report: cckit status reads the repository now; the sprint review is a decision about the next sprint.
